description: Current weather at a place: temperature (°C), humidity (%), pressure (hPa) and wind (m/s) from the nearest live Open-Meteo relay within 75 km, with a signed receipt. Pass latitude and longitude, or a city. Costs $0.001 per call. The first 5 priced calls per caller are free.

city.description: A city instead of coordinates, e.g. "Tokyo"; many spellings work (Токио, 東京).

name: weather_now
